scene: The stone frog holds a glowing brass key in its open mouth.
picture: Flat side view on a wet stone walkway. On the far left, a giant floating lilypad bobs against the path. Left of centre, the player stands beside a stone frog fountain at the centre. Farther right sits a wooden park bench, and on the far right waits a brightly painted snail bus with doors open.
shown: a tiny brass key glowing faintly inside the stone frog mouth in the centre
a broad floating giant lilypad moored by a rope on the far left
a passenger bus shaped like a giant snail waiting on the far right

variants.scene: A shiny brass key glimmers inside the stone frog's splashing mouth.
Cool fountain water sprays past a tiny glowing key in the frog.
The fountain splashes softly, reminding you of {tune} as a key shines.
